messages.subject_clean: Collapsing and scaling nodes on a treedatalist
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I can plot multiple beast trees "allTrees" using:
ggtree(allTrees, aes(colour=host) + facet_wrap(~.id, scale="free", ncol=5) +
theme_tree2()

On an individual tree I can scale and collapse a node by:
ggtree(tree1, aes(colour=host) %>%
  scaleClade(MRCA(tree1, grep("Human",tree1@phylo$tip.label)),.2) %>%
  collapse(MRCA(tree1, grep("Human",tree1@phylo$tip.label)), mode="max", fill="blue")

How can I access the Human nodes for each of the trees on "allTrees" and then scale/collapse?

James
